value.rationale: Panhandle polytopes are canonical hypersimplex cut-off pieces in the paving matroid theory of arXiv:2201.12442. Their intrinsic affine-symmetry invariant and complete set of minimizing centers are naturally motivated but not provided by published Ehrhart/volume formulas. Distinct regimes produce unique centers, \((p-1)\)-dimensional centers and \((t-1)\)-dimensional centers, plus sharp rigidity at ties. The contribution is a universal classification with structural transitions, not arbitrary finite computation or a small normalization check.
